notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Merchants![/p][p]We've overhauled the game to tackle some unfortunate issues that have been plaguing players since the game launched in March. We appreciate everyone's support and immense patience as we ironed this all out.[/p][p][b][u]Please note that this patch will go live tomorrow on June 27th, 2025 at 11:30 AM Central Time / 12:30 PM Eastern Time.[/u][/b][/p][p]If you continue to run into the issues that were meant to be fixed in this patch, please join our Discord server and utilize our bug report forums to let us know.[/p][p][/p][h2]1.0.3 Patch Notes[/h2][h3][b]Quests[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]"Appeal to the City"[/b] quest intro playing twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the [b]"Write Mehdi A Letter"[/b] quest description.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]"New Recruits"[/b] quest recruitment date.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]"Chasing An Echo"[/b] quest deadline text.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the unused quest, [b]"Stationary Work"[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added Renown 8 completion to [b]"FREE Business"[/b] to allow the player to complete the quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the [b]"Echo Lake"[/b] quest dates to avoid overlap with with other quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the quest rewards section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed quest locations not appearing without a reload.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Player Shop & Companions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Potentially fixed the issue with Front Of House assignments causing your shop to crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the End Of Week percentage to always equate to 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix item price resetting the quantity to 1 when selecting a different item.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Front Of House companion slots not updating the Back Of House companion slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the upgrade button playing sounds when you can't afford the upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Front Of House assignment stats resetting when leaving the Front Of House UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Companions now face their workstations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Rumor containers by preventing them from expanding the End of Day results.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shelves appearing stocked when they're empty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Companion assignment not being aborted when leaving the Back Of House UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Force the player to hire a Companion when available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed players to level a Companion multiple times at once.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Settings, Saves, & UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Prevented the Save menu from refreshing multiple times.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Settings menu checking a default setting that is no longer in use.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Back To Menu button in the credits not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Save slot to reflect the currently loaded save data in memory, which should also display the correct checkpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Disable escaping on the Game Over screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-resized item tags.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resizing on event labels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tooltips displaying off-screen at specific resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a description to the item, Piccolo Sheet Music.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the Map button to stop the player from not closing any pop-up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Compendium cards loading after setting pin status, update pin stats when Compendium details are loaded from a fresh save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pop-ups appearing more than once when hitting enter.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the crafting icon above the item icon in inventory items.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Dialogue[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the issue with dialogue failing and causing the game to hang.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed excess fades in dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down dialogue skip to avoid characters appearing incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added auto resizing text labels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the edge case bug where you can skip to finishing the game early.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue sometimes wiping the active quest.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed duplicate events from generating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed time tracking regarding the amount of hours played.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Ambience playing on the local map.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Marketplace and ItemDetails to help the load time of shops, especially during end-game stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the NPC Gems not taking the player's money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bundle purchase sounds being used for other purchases.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed progression issues for 2 quests: Guilded Union, Messenger Seagull.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze on an End Of Week screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an unwarranted "Game Over" fail state.
[*] Minor fixes and edits like typos, music issues, and Quill requirements for a quest.
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Week Patch
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, Merchants!

Our first patch is now live! Thank you so much for everyone's support and patience as we worked on fixing the bugs that popped up during our launch week. 

If you continue to run into the issues that were meant to be fixed in this patch, please join our Discord server and utilize our bug report forums to let us know.

[b]1.0.1 Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed memory leaks that were causing crashes / overuse of resources on some PCs.
[*] Made improvements to how the save system works.
[*] Fixed the issue where the Workshop Wonderland achievement wasn't unlocking. (Don't worry, this achievement will now pop up for anyone that unlocked it before the patch!)
[*] Fixed issues where some quests were not completing on specific in-game dates.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some objective locations to disappear after loading in.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused freezing during the day transition animation.
[*] Updated the descriptions on some quests that didn't have enough information.
[/list]
